institutionName: University of Natural Resources and Life Sciences, Vienna (BOKU)

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: It was three main aspects that were crucial to choose Vienna: 1) experience in a new and unfamiliar city 2) career opportunities, and 3) academic opportunities.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: It was very easy to orient myself upon arrival.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I received tours of the campus and city, and help navigating my way around the academic structure of the university.

questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was very easy for me as I had a friend who let me rent his room.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is very important to start looking early for off campus housing, the best advice is to join facebook apartment renting groups.

questions.answer: It involved scheduling a 5 minute meeting at the main office of student services, where you provide some documentation and you receive your student id card and registration.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There was help through buddy programs and online resources.

questions.answer: Varying degrees of difficulty, some way more challenging and fit for a masters program, and some seemed like intro bachelors level courses.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Style at UCPH is much better overall, professors are more interactive and take their job as teachers much more seriously.

questions.answer: Try your best to learn german, but also just show interest in austrian culture.
